text: Good until it's not. I think the app is overpriced. It's not something I would personally pay that much for. Anyone can expect this app to work flawlessly, or as close to flawlessly as possible, for the first few days, and then all of a sudden it will make silly mistakes on purpose just to get you to pay for the full version, which I would have done, but not at that price, and not when they encourage people to buy it with that kind of tactic.
